name: cache-handoff
description: Status line with context size and prompt-cache warmth, plus /hc: /compact with state-keeping instructions, also fired by itself before the prompt cache goes cold

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: TTL used to estimate when the prompt cache expires (1h on a subscription, 5m in overage)

bandAtTokens.title: Show the handoff band from
bandAtTokens.description: Context size in tokens from which the compact band shows above the prompt and the auto /hc may fire

autoHcMinutes.title: Auto /hc before the cache expires
autoHcMinutes.description: Run /hc by itself this many minutes before the prompt cache expires, when the session is idle and the context is at least the band threshold; 0 turns it off

autoHcForceMinutes.title: Auto /hc regardless of context size
autoHcForceMinutes.description: Run /hc by itself this many minutes before the prompt cache expires when the session is idle, whatever the context size (1h TTL only); 0 turns it off
